title: Trace-fingerprint ingest adapter and ordered fanout
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: our current log ingress normalizes correlation IDs but loses ordering guarantees when tenant fanout and multi-sink routing happen. This causes downstream trace reconstruction to mis-order events and makes latency/error dashboards show spikes that do not match request timelines.

Objective: introduce a lightweight ingest adapter that computes a stable 'trace fingerprint' (deterministic digest of timestamp + span hints + tenant context) and attach it to structured logs at the edge. Pair this with an ordered fanout queue for each fingerprint window so downstream consumers (Loki/ELK and the trace rehydration service) can rely on causal ordering without introducing per-tenant hot shards. The adapter must be low-latency (<2ms avg added), configurable (window size, digest salt), and backwards-compatible (falls back to existing correlation propagation).
acceptance_criteria: Edge adapter implemented as a sidecar plugin and deployed to canary fleet (5% traffic)
Average added latency per request from adapter measured <2ms under 95th percentile in canary
Trace fingerprint field (redwood.trace_fingerprint) present on >=99.5% of structured logs in canary tenant set
Ordered fanout guarantees: consumers receive events for a given fingerprint in ingest-order (as defined by adapter-generated monotonic sequence id) for windows up to configured 30s
No increase in tail error-rate for downstream Loki ingestion (>0.1% relative increase triggers rollback)
Automated e2e test that reconstructs a 50-event trace across service boundaries and asserts ordering and completeness in the trace rehydration pipeline
Rollout playbook and rollback procedure documented and rehearsed with SRE
tasks: Design spec: trace fingerprint algorithm, salt management, sequence id, and compression scheme
Implement sidecar adapter (Go) with config flags for window size and salt (feature-flagged)
Add ordered fanout layer: per-fingerprint window queue with ack/backoff semantics (Kafka topic + compacting index)
Instrument metrics: adapter_latency_ms, fingerprint_hit_ratio, fanout_enqueue_depth, fanout_consumer_lag
Write e2e harness that simulates cross-service traces with intentionally reordered network delivery to validate reconstruction
Performance test: 10k rps canary against representative tenant set, capture p50/p95/p99 adapter overhead
Create dashboards: fingerprint coverage, ordering violations, fanout lag, downstream Loki error rate
Prepare rollout runbook and coordinate SRE/PM/Design review
Code review, security review for digest salt handling and KMS integration
Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks and automated rollback thresholds
